overview_description.description:
inari helps its clients operate as next generation insurance and reinsurance organizations both for greenfield operations and long-established companies serving MGAs, Insurance Carriers, Lloyd’s Syndicates and Reinsurance worlwide.

We provide core insurance policy administration, underwriting dashboard and bordereaux management systems using a secure, cloud based, natively API enabled, fully managed service that combines next generation technology and deep product and insurance experience.

We provide a modern, easy-to-use tool that manages the end-to-end policy lifecycle, handling the ‘heavy lifting’ of day-to-day (re)insurance process management. The platforms provide frictionless interconnectivity and integration with other systems and data sources, which enriches the risk lifecycle experience. Using proprietary technology for data ingestion and capture, it provides users with agile, digital-first underwriting and risk management that has the potential to increase operational efficiency, enhance data accuracy, improve data distribution through the value chain and lower costs.
